formulations.text: The acceleration of a system is directly proportional to and in the same direction as the net external force acting on the system, and inversely proportional to its mass.
a = F_net / m; F_net = m a

notes: Status empirical: source says the proportionalities were found/verified experimentally (blocks p-6, p-10, p-12). Verbal and mathematical formulations are treated as representations of one underlying Statement.
